subject: Post-call primer & request: exec bridge to unblock pilot
messages:
From: Sam Jensen <sam.jensen@marketgrid.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-12T14:03:00-07:00
Subject: Quick follow-up and ask after today's discovery

Hi Evelyn / Karthik / Marissa —

Thanks again for carving out time today. Useful conversation — a couple of quick notes and a request to keep momentum: 

Summary of what we heard from our side:
- Primary goal: reduce inference cost while preserving 99th-percentile latency for our customer-facing recommendation flow (50–200 tokens per request).
- Constraints: HIPAA-ish data handling for certain payer data, private VPC for production, and a hard SLA window for peak traffic.
- Success metric we care about: latency under 120ms p95 and a 40% reduction in per-token cost vs current setup.

As discussed, the next unblocking step internally is a short executive intro (VP Eng / CTO) so our leadership can confirm procurement runway and approve a pilot kickoff. Could we schedule a 30-minute VP/CTO bridge next week? Available windows on our side:
- Tue 8/17: 10:00–11:00 PT
- Wed 8/18: 14:00–15:00 PT
- Thu 8/19: 09:00–10:00 PT

I attached our internal discovery notes for reference. If you prefer, I can loop in Lina Torres (VP Engineering) directly — she's the final approver for pilots.

Attachments: [Attachment: MarketGrid-Discovery-Notes.pdf]

Thanks,
Sam Jensen
Director, Platform Engineering
MarketGrid

Sam —

Really appreciate the clear summary and the sample windows. We're aligned on the ask — a 30-minute exec bridge makes sense to unblock procurement and the pilot.

Proposed approach from our side:
1) Internal sync (15 min) between Karthik + Marissa + me to align the agenda and confirm the one-pager we want to present.
2) Exec bridge (30 min) with your VP Eng + our Head of Product (Marissa) and me for context and next-steps.

Can you confirm which of your proposed windows works best? We can hold space tentatively for Tue 8/17 10:00 PT and I'll send a calendar invite once you confirm attendees. 

Also attaching an internal one-pager we use for execs (very brief) — will tailor it to MarketGrid before the bridge.

Attachments: [Attachment: Exec-OnePager-Redwood.pdf]

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Looping in a few technical clarifications so we make the 30-min bridge actionable: 

Agenda suggestions (30 min):
- 5 min: introductions & success criteria (Evelyn + Sam)
- 10 min: proposed pilot scope & expected performance (Karthik)
- 10 min: operational guardrails (data path, VPC/KMS, SOC2 evidence) (Marissa)
- 5 min: next steps & decision points (Evelyn)

Pre-reads that would help:
- Typical traffic profile (QPS by time of day)
- Sequence length distribution (p50/p95/p99 tokens)
- Any minimum uptime/SLO commitments you need

I've attached a draft mutual-action-plan with tentative gates so we can show concrete milestone dates during the bridge. If you can send the traffic profile ahead of the call, I'll bring a couple of quantization and batch-config options to the meeting.

Attachments: [Attachment: Draft-MAP-v1.xlsx]

—Karthik
